claim: Apple's fiscal 2025 revenue of $416.2 billion was generated in the fourth quarter.
summary: The $416.2 billion figure is Apple's full fiscal 2025 annual total, not fourth-quarter revenue. Q4 was about one-quarter of that, so attributing the annual total to Q4 alone is false.

sub_claims.text: Apple's total fiscal 2025 revenue was $416.2 billion
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge, Apple's full fiscal 2025 total revenue was about $416.2 billion, the sum of its four quarterly results.

sub_claims.text: That $416.2 billion was generated in the fourth quarter alone
sub_claims.stated_text: was generated in the fourth quarter
sub_claims.note: From own knowledge, $416.2 billion is the full-year total, not a single quarter; fiscal Q4 2025 was about $102.5 billion.
